subject: Aperture Health expansion — forecast triage & CS readiness
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@aperturehealth.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2027-06-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Aperture Health expansion — request to confirm forecasted ARR and stage

Hi team / Samir,

Quick context: Aperture Health is looking to expand from 10 seats to 45 seats and add Redwood Optimize for latency-sensitive inference. Samir indicated intent during last week’s exec call and we need to firm up the forecast before tomorrow’s revops commit window.

Ask: can we get a short readout on CS readiness and a firm commit number for Q3 forecast? Specifically:
- Confirm committed expansion ARR (best-effort number + confidence level)
- Any open blockers CS needs to resolve prior to go-live (training, SSO, data onboarding)
- Proposed go-live / invoicing month (Jul/Aug)

I attached a quick mutual action template (Aperture_MAT_2027.xlsx) with proposed milestones. Samir, if you can confirm the ideal billing cadence we’ll align finance.

Timeline: RevOps needs a forecast update by EOD 2027-06-01 so Marcus can include in the commit.

Thanks — I’ll run through numbers once we have CS input.

Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
From: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@aperturehealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aperture Health expansion — request to confirm forecasted ARR and stage

Thanks Karthik — looping in CS to surface readiness.

Preliminary proposal for the commit window:
- Proposed committed ARR: $156,000 (45 seats + Optimize add-on)
- Confidence: Medium (75%) pending SSO and data ingest dry run
- Proposed go-live: 2027-08-01 (targeting start of billing in August)

Monica — can you confirm the following by 1pm PST?
- Health snapshot (usage, onboarding blockers, P0/P1 items)
- Any customer asks that would materially change the timeline (e.g., additional integrations)

Samir — if these numbers look close, please confirm and call out billing preference (net-30 vs net-45). If you need a shorter window for go-live, let us know and we’ll update the MAT.

I’m happy to jump on a 15-min call if that speeds things up.

Cheers,
Priya Natarajan
Senior Revenue Ops Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@aperturehealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T12:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aperture Health expansion — request to confirm forecasted ARR and stage

@Priya — quick CS health snapshot below (summary + attachments). I also left inline notes in the MAT.

CS Health Snapshot (high level):
- Current usage: 10 seats, average token throughput low-to-medium (no production Optimize traffic yet)
- Onboarding readiness: SSO mostly done (IdP metadata pending), initial data ingest tests successful for 2/3 datasets
- QBR scheduled: 2027-07-12 (alignment meeting with their platform and security leads)
- Risks: data transformation for one legacy source may add 2-3 weeks if they opt to include it; training sessions required for 20 power users (we can schedule in July)
- Customer sentiment: positive — they’ve given a verbal nod to expanding; finance is the gating factor for final signoff

Recommended next steps from CS:
1) Lock a short dry-run window in July (2-week pilot for Optimize)
2) Finish IdP metadata exchange by 2027-06-10 (Samir / Aperture action)
3) Schedule two training sessions before go-live (dates proposed in MAT)

Attachments: CS_Health_Snapshot_AH.pdf (2-page), I added notes in Aperture_MAT_2027.xlsx.

If RevOps needs a risk-adjusted number, I’d suggest: Committed ARR = $132,600 (85% of proposed) to account for the potential 2-3 week delay.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Samir Patel <samir@aperturehealth.com>
Date: 2027-06-01T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aperture Health expansion — request to confirm forecasted ARR and stage

Thanks everyone — I pulled the numbers into the commit sheet and made a conservative adjustment per Monica’s risk call.

RevOps update (for the commit):
- Record: AH-EXP-27
- Forecasted committed ARR (revops): $132,600 (risk-adjusted)
- Commit code for reporting: 20270601-AH-EXP-27
- Notes: track IdP metadata exchange and Optimize pilot status; if pilot completes successfully by 2027-07-20 we’ll flip to full commit and update the forecast in the next cadence.

Samir — please confirm billing cadence (net-30 or net-45) and whether you want us to send a pro-forma invoice to speed approval. We can also add an invoice holdback clause if your procurement team needs it.

Next steps
- Samir: confirm IdP metadata and billing cadence (ASAP)
- Monica: confirm pilot window dates in the MAT and confirm training slots
- Karthik/Priya: I’ll publish the commit note after Samir confirms.

Marcus Lin
RevOps Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: revops-commit-adjustment-notes.txt
